title: Acids, Bases & Salts

sections.heading: 1. pH Scale & Acid-Base Indicators
sections.proseLatex: $\text{pH} = -\log[H^+]$. Acidic: pH < 7, basic: pH > 7. Indicators change color at endpoints.

sections.heading: 2. Mole Concept, Normality & Molarity
sections.proseLatex: Avogadro's number, mole concept. Normality $= $ eq/L, molarity $= $ mol/L, molality $= $ mol/kg.

workedExamples.problemLatex: Solution X has pH 6, Y has pH 7. How many times is X more acidic than Y?

wbjeebTraps: pH is a logarithmic scale — each unit change = 10× change in $[H^+]$.
Salt hydrolysis: salt of weak acid + strong base gives basic solution.
